title: C¹ local inverse with surjective inverse derivative (inverse function theorem on ℝ^d)
statement: Let d ∈ ℕ, Φ : ℝ^d → ℝ^d (Euclid d), V ⊆ ℝ^d open and v₀ ∈ V. Assume Φ is C¹ on V and its derivative DΦ(v₀) is injective. Then there exist open sets V₁, O ⊆ ℝ^d and a map H : ℝ^d → ℝ^d such that v₀ ∈ V₁ ⊆ V, Φ(v₀) ∈ O, H is C¹ on O, H(O) = V₁, Φ(H(w)) = w for every w ∈ O, and the derivative DH(w) is surjective for every w ∈ O.
lean_statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (Φ : Euclid d → Euclid d) (V : Set (Euclid d)) (v₀ : Euclid d), IsOpen V → v₀ ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Φ V → Injective (fderiv ℝ Φ v₀) → ∃ (V₁ O : Set (Euclid d)) (H : Euclid d → Euclid d), IsOpen V₁ ∧ IsOpen O ∧ v₀ ∈ V₁ ∧ V₁ ⊆ V ∧ Φ v₀ ∈ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 H O ∧ H '' O = V₁ ∧ (∀ w ∈ O, Φ (H w) = w) ∧ ∀ w ∈ O, Surjective (fderiv ℝ H w)
